messages.text: Ananya. Phone's alive again. Sixty rupees coming back - I'm a woman of my word, mostly.
Next Sunday, bamboo, four o'clock. Bring the smile-less face.
Sent you the bandstand one. You looked like a tourist. In a good way.
(a ten-second clip: G, C, D, and one wrong note at the end)
Okay. That was not bad. That was almost a song.
Walked past Church Street — the guitar man says you bought the spruce top. Concert when?
